content: निपत् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To fall or come down, descend, alight, sink down; निपतन्ती पतिमप्यपातयत् <ls>R. 8. 38</ls>; <ls>Bk. 15. 27</ls>. .²2 To be cast at, be directed towards; निपेतुरन्तःकरणैर्नरेन्द्राः <ls>R. 6. 11</ls>. .²3 To throw oneself down (as at the feet), fall prostrate; देवास्तदन्ते हरमूढभार्यं किरीटबद्धाञ्जलयो निपत्य <ls>Ku. 7. 92</ls>; <ls>R. 4. 50</ls>; <ls>Bh. 2. 31</ls>. .²4 To fall or descend into, meet in; त्वय्येव निपतन्त्योघा जाह्नवीया इवार्णवे <ls>R. 10. 26</ls>. .²5 To fall upon, attack, rush at or upon; सिंहो शिशुरपि निपतति मदमलिनकपोलभित्तिषु गजेषु <ls>Bh. 2. 38</ls>. .²6 To happen, occur, take place, fall to oneʼs lot; सकृदंशो निपतति <ls>Ms. 9. 47</ls>. .²7 To be placed, occupy a place; अभ्यर्हितं पूर्वं निपतति. .²8 To flow in, discharge into. .²9 To fall into ruin. .²10 To fall into (any state). .²11 To be miscarried (as the foetus). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to fall down, throw or hurl down. .²2 To kill, destroy; तातं निपात्य सह बन्धुजनाक्षितोयैः <ls>Mu. 5. 7</ls>; <ls>Pt. 3. 63</ls>. .²3 To inlay, emboss. .²4 To direct (the eyes) upon. .²5 To spit out. .²6 To raise or levy (as a tribute). .²7 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) To put down as a special or irregular form, to mention as an irregular formation; एते पञ्चविंशतिरजन्ता निपात्यन्ते <ls>Sk.</ls>
